description: node-GTFS is BlinkTag's Node.js library and command-line toolkit for importing, querying and exporting public-transport schedules. It reads static GTFS feeds into SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, with additional SQLite functions for GTFS-Realtime updates, geographic queries and export back to GTFS files. Inputs are provider feeds and import settings; outputs are queryable schedule databases and derived tables or GeoJSON. Coverage is global but depends on the chosen operator's feed and service dates. Public source and npm installation are free under MIT, and the reviewed release requires Node.js 22 or newer. A limitation is that static imports replace existing GTFS tables, and the newer PostgreSQL/MySQL support does not yet provide all SQLite features. Feed quality and upstream access terms remain separate from the software licence. The toolkit can prepare schedules and transit-network inputs for simulations with SUMO (model-sumo). Its README provides import, query and update examples and a feature-support matrix. No transit archive or live vehicle feed was downloaded.
name: node-GTFS transit-data toolkit
